AGENDA
  PARKLANDS COMMITTEE
  SEPTEMBER 10, 2015

Council Chambers  Thursday
City Hall  September 10, 2015
340 Palos Verdes Drive West  7:30 p.m.
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in
appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the
Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 378-0383, at least 48
hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.

Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on
all appropriate items on Tuesday, September 22, 2015.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

COMMUNICATIONS FROM PUBLIC

Members of the audience are invited to address the Committee at this time on items that
are not otherwise on the agenda. Per the California Government Code Section 54954.2,
the Parklands Committee is prohibited from discussing or taking immediate action on any
item not on the agenda unless it can be demonstrated that the item is of an emergency
nature, or the need to take action arose subsequent to the posting of the agenda.

minutes_text:
ACTION MEMO
  PARKLANDS COMMITTEE
  SEPTEMBER 10, 2015

Council Chambers  Thursday
City Hall  September 10, 2015
340 Palos Verdes Drive West  7:30 p.m.
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on
all appropriate items on Tuesday, September 22, 2015.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL  Members present: Peterson, Wade, Richie-Bray &
  Rubincam

  Members absent: Kaviani

COMMUNICATIONS FROM PUBLIC

    None

OLD BUSINESS

1.  Update on the City’s water usage to address the drought.

Action: Reviewed and filed.

2.  Conceptual landscape design for the triangle area at Palos Verdes Drive West and
  Palos Verdes Drive North intersection.

 Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on all
  appropriate items on Tuesday, September 22, 2015.
  Director’s initials SR-L
 Action: Rubincam motioned seconded by Wade to approve Plan # 3. Additionally,
applying green dye to the triangle area and the median adjacent to City Hall was
recommended. The vote was (4-0, Kaviani absent).

CITIZEN APPLICATION

3.  PC-CTP-02-15; Concent plan to renovate a parklands section of Paseo Lunado
  located adjacent to a stormwater outfall structure and near Lunada Bay
  Elementary School with indigenous/native landscaping, seating areas (benches or
  boulders) and a decomposed granite walking path.

  Applicant:  Lunada Bay Homeowners Association
  1633 Chelsea Road
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Action: Committee member Wade motioned seconded by Rubicam to approve the
application. The vote was (4-0, Kaviani absent).

4.  PC-CTP-01-15; Concept plan to restrict pedestrian access on a section of the
  Paseo Del sol asphalt fire road adjacent to residential property on Via Elevado
  and to establish a pedestrian pathway/trail above the fire road.

  Applicant:  Jim D’Angelo
  2716 Via Elevado
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Action: Richie-Bray motioned seconded by Wade to deny the application. The vote
was (4-0, Kaviani absent).

5.  PC-399-15; Application to remove 1 Carob tree located in the parkway adjacent
  to 2609 Via Rivera.

  Applicant:  Marisa and John Kunich
  2609 Via Rivera
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Action: Rubincam motioned seconded by Wade to approve this application. The
applicant is approved to remove 1 Carob tree located adjacent to 2609 Via Rivera
according to the ‘Standard Conditions for Tree Removal Approvals’ to include
removal of the stump. A $500 payment to the ‘Tree Bank’ is required. The vote was
(4-0 Kaviani absent).

 Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on all
  appropriate items on Tuesday, September 22, 2015.
  Director’s initials SR-L
 6.  PC-406-15; Application to remove 1 Olive tree located in the parkway adjacent to
  532 Via Almar.

  Applicant:  Susan Whelan
  532 Via Almar
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Action: This item was heard out of the agenda order and followed the discussion of
Item 2 for the conceptual landscape design for the triangle area. Rubincam
motioned Richie-Bray seconded to approve this application. The applicant is
approved to remove 1 Olive tree located in the parkway adjacent to 532 Via Almar
according to the ‘Standard Conditions for Tree Removal Approvals’ to include
removal of the stump. The applicant is required to pay $500 to the ‘Tree Bank’.
The vote was (3-1, Wade dissenting and Kaviani absent).

7.  PC-407-15; Application to remove 1 Ficus tree located in the parkway adjacent to
  709 Yarmouth Road.

  Applicant:  John and Beth Peterson
  709 Yarmouth Road
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Action: Peterson motioned Wade seconded to approve this application. The
applicant is approved to remove 1 Ficus tree located in the parkway adjacent to
Yarmouth Road according to the ‘Standard Conditions for Tree Removal
Approvals’ to include removal of the stump. A $500 payment to the ‘Tree Bank’ is
required. The vote was (4-0, Kaviani absent).

NEW BUSINESS

None

ITEMS OF INFORMATION FROM THE COMMITTEE/STAFF

8.  Update on current applications

Action: Reviewed and filed.

ADJOURNMENT

The Committee is adjourned to October 8, 2015.

 Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on all
  appropriate items on Tuesday, September 22, 2015.
  Director’s initials SR-L
